name: Kokoro-82M
tagline: 82M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model running fast on CPU
real_test_summary: Generated 30 seconds of 24kHz audio in 1.8s on Apple M2 CPU with under 1.2GB RAM usage.

description: Lightweight 82-million-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model delivering natural voices locally on CPU or entry-level GPUs without cloud API fees.
